seo.title: About David Sandoval — Software Engineer
seo.description: Learn how David Sandoval approaches software engineering across backend systems, web products, testing, developer tooling and applied research.

summary: Backend-oriented Software Engineer with frontend experience. I connect technical decisions with business context, build maintainable web products and validate changes through testing and reproducible workflows.
biography: Backend-oriented Software Engineer with frontend experience across .NET, Angular and TypeScript. I value clear architecture when it reduces delivery risk, not as an objective by itself.

My professional work includes modernizing frontend modules, contributing to REST APIs, improving data and reporting workflows, expanding automated regression coverage and supporting migrations from legacy systems. I document project decisions, trade-offs and validation so the engineering behind the work is easier to understand.

Alongside product engineering, I research Mining Software Repositories and the use of BiLSTM models to study OSS project abandonment, currently in progress toward my professional degree. This research is a secondary specialization that complements my software-engineering work.
focusAreas: Maintainable backend systems and API boundaries
Automated testing and CI quality gates
availabilityStatement: Open to remote software engineering opportunities, including international relocation or graduate study as part of ongoing career growth.
researchSummary: Researching OSS abandonment prediction with BiLSTM models and repository activity data as part of ongoing thesis work.
currentRoleSummary: I currently work at Atena as a Jr. Software Engineer, backend-oriented with frontend experience across Angular and .NET. My focus is maintainable delivery, validated changes and clear technical documentation.
